fields.label: WIP Bin Mode
fields.description: Standard Quantity preserves visual full-bin capacity. Loose Multi-Item permits only explicitly authorized Items and has no fixed capacity.

fields.label: Loose WIP Consumption Posting
fields.description: Every operation-card cycle records immutable physical usage. CFG Kanban consolidates the accumulated quantity into one native ERPNext consumption at Work Order close.

fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The Job Card operation allowed to receive and consume these visually controlled bins. Each physical-bin row identifies its workstation so parallel stations can share this operation pool.

fields.label: WIP Warehouse
fields.description: ERPNext Warehouse represented by every fixed bin in this pool.

fields.label: Floor Verification Controls
fields.description: Standard pools use visual full-bin verification. Loose pools use an explicit Item allow-list and immutable usage records. Neither replaces ERPNext Stock Entry confirmation.

fields.label: Require WIP Bin Scan
fields.description: The operator must scan the permanent physical bin before the operation may use its load.

fields.label: Require Full-bin Consumption
fields.description: When checked, a lower actual-use quantity requires the enabled Supervisor exception. This control does not apply to Loose Multi-Item pools.

fields.label: Allow Supervisor Partial-bin Exception
fields.description: Keep disabled for fixed-capacity production. This control does not apply to Loose Multi-Item pools.

fields.label: Approved Physical Bins by Workstation
fields.description: Each bin must have the reusable role matching this Pool mode. Map every bin to its physical Workstation; one bin can belong to only one pool.

fields.label: Reusable WIP Bins
fields.options: CFG Kanban WIP Bin Pool Entry
